messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I just have a couple of quick questions. First, I want to check how much is left on my gift card. Also, for my most recent order, I can’t remember if I used my Visa, Mastercard, or Amex—can you tell me which one I used? And if possible, I’d like to use my gift card balance for that order instead. If that’s not allowed, I’d like to switch the payment to my Visa. Can you help me with all this?

Yes—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please tell me the **email address** you used for your purchase (or, if you prefer, your **first name + last name + ZIP code**). Once I find your account, I’ll:
1) check your **gift card balance**  
2) look up your **most recent order** and tell you whether it was **Visa / Mastercard / Amex**  
3) if the order is still **pending**, help you switch payment to **gift card** (or, if gift card isn’t allowed/doesn’t cover the amount, switch to **Visa**)
Sure, my email is isabella.lopez3271@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else!
Yes, please go ahead and pull up the details for order #W4923227. I’d really appreciate it!
